data.name: OVERCHESS
data.detailed_description:
YOU KNOW HOW TO PLAY CHESS, RIGHT??

You are just a regular pawn — alone against the entire open world. This is infinite multidimensional chess with pocket dimensions. Strategy, adventures and a bit of horror chess where the pawn has a brain and can modernize himself.

The pawn decided to pass 19 000 blocks and he will do it. On the way he will meet friends and enemies that no one expected — alcoholism, ludomania, diseases, crocodiles. Make friends, enemies, slaves, worms. Collect your own army.

Avoid incurable diseases, unnecessary decisions — only to die anyway from a random quantum fluctuation. Try to change your fate. Just do whatever you want in these damn chess. Excessive, infinite, multidimensional chess with pocket dimensions.

Got it??? (There is also cool music and possibly a plot.)

EXCESSIVE, INFINITE, MULTIDIMENSIONAL CHESS

WITH POCKET DIMENSIONS!!!!

GOT IT???   

(There's also cool music and possibly a plot)

data.short_description: You are a pawn in an endless but not always fair chess world. Enslave your enemies and turn them into slaves. Build your own army. On the path to glory you will face alcoholism, alligators and ludomania. Test your luck in OVERCHESS.
